name: Daniel 'Danny' Hayes
bio:
Danny Hayes' journey into motorsports began with a childhood fascination for go-karts and a knack for tinkering with engines. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics. His early career involved stints in various junior racing series, where he honed his skills in data analysis and problem-solving. A breakthrough came when he helped a small IndyCar team punch above its weight, securing several unexpected podium finishes through innovative setup strategies.

Joining Ferrari AF Corse was a dream come true for Danny. He's known for his meticulous approach to race preparation, spending hours poring over telemetry data to identify even the smallest performance gains. While some engineers can get bogged down in theory, Danny excels at translating complex data into practical adjustments that drivers can feel on the track. He's a firm believer in open communication, fostering a collaborative environment where drivers and mechanics can freely share their feedback.

Danny's ability to adapt to changing track conditions and driver preferences sets him apart. He's not afraid to deviate from established strategies and explore unconventional solutions, always with the goal of maximizing performance. A perfectionist at heart, he relentlessly pursues every last tenth of a second, pushing both himself and the team to new heights.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Danny has a lean build with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool in his pocket.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his notebook when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout race weekends.
